Introduction

X:IN is a five-member multinational girl group under BeBy Entertainment. They debuted on April 11, 2023, with the single "Keeping the Fire", after pre-releasing "Who Am I" in March 2023.

Member Chi.U left the group in June 2023 due to personal reasons, followed by Roa in July 2023; new members Hannah and Nizz then joined.

Originally under Escrow Entertainment, it was announced, on April 9, 2025, that all members had terminated their contract with Escrow and would now continue their activites under their new agency, Beby Entertainment.
